name: Refugees by Country of Origin (total stock, end-year)
note: End-year stock of people recognized as refugees originating from each country; core displacement pressure signal

name: Refugees by Country of Asylum (total stock, end-year)
note: End-year stock of refugees hosted in each country; measures humanitarian burden and regional spillover

name: Asylum Seekers by Country of Origin (pending stock, end-year)
note: Pending asylum applications originating from each country; early-warning outflow indicator before recognition

name: Asylum Seekers by Country of Asylum (pending stock, end-year)
note: Pending asylum claims hosted in each country; measures asylum system pressure and irregular migration flows

name: Internally Displaced Persons (UNHCR-reported, end-year stock)
note: UNHCR's own IDP stock estimates (separate from IDMC); measures internal displacement in countries UNHCR has operational mandate

name: Returned Refugees (annual flow)
note: Annual flow of refugees who returned to their country of origin; durable-solution indicator, signals conflict resolution

name: Returned IDPs (annual flow)
note: Annual flow of IDPs who returned to place of origin; signals internal conflict abatement and stabilization

name: Stateless Persons (end-year stock)
note: Count of persons without any nationality; indicator of ethnic/citizenship discrimination and governance failure

name: Others of Concern to UNHCR (end-year stock)
note: Persons not fitting standard refugee/IDP/stateless categories but needing protection; catch-all vulnerability signal

name: Other People in Need of International Protection (end-year stock)
note: People needing international protection outside the 1951 Convention definition; expanded vulnerability measure

name: Host Community Population (persons in host communities, end-year)
note: Persons in communities hosting significant displaced populations; proxy for absorption burden and local tension risk

name: New Asylum Applications Filed (annual flow, country of asylum)
note: Annual count of new asylum claims submitted to each country's system; real-time pull-factor and crisis magnitude indicator

name: New Asylum Applications by Country of Origin (annual flow)
note: Annual asylum claims originating from each country; push-factor signal reflecting persecution or conflict intensity

name: Asylum Decisions — Recognized (refugee status granted, annual)
note: Number of positive refugee status determinations per year; indicates severity of origin-country conditions as assessed internationally

name: Asylum Decisions — Rejected (annual)
note: Number of rejected asylum claims per year; combined with recognitions yields recognition rate, a proxy for legitimate refugee claims

name: Asylum Decisions — Closed/Otherwise (annual)
note: Administrative closures of asylum claims; signals procedural efficiency or backlog management in asylum countries

name: Refugee Recognition Rate (derived: recognized / total decisions, annual)
note: Share of decided claims that receive refugee status; internationally accepted measure of origin-country threat level

name: Resettlement Departures (annual flow, by country of origin)
note: Refugees departing for resettlement in a third country; durable solution flow, inverse signal to ongoing crisis severity

name: Resettlement Submissions (annual, by country of origin)
note: UNHCR cases submitted for resettlement consideration; leading indicator of pipeline before departure

name: Naturalizations (refugees naturalized in country of asylum, annual)
note: Refugees acquiring citizenship in host country; durable solution indicator, signals permanent integration vs return

name: Refugees as Share of Origin Country Population (derived)
note: Refugees from country / total population; normalizes for country size, key comparability metric for ML features

name: IDPs as Share of Country Population (derived)
note: UNHCR IDP stock / total population; normalized internal displacement burden, comparability-adjusted

name: UNRWA-Mandated Refugees (Palestine refugees, end-year)
note: Palestine refugee population under UNRWA mandate by host country; key for MENA political-risk features

name: IDMC IDP Stock (UNHCR/IDMC combined, end-year)
note: IDP figures from IDMC as relayed through UNHCR population API /idmc/ endpoint; broader IDP coverage than UNHCR alone

name: Total Forcibly Displaced (refugees + asylum-seekers + IDPs, derived)
note: Aggregate forced displacement burden for a country; single composite signal for ML feature engineering

name: Resettlement Submissions — Male Share (demographics, annual)
note: Gender composition of resettlement pipeline; demographic disaggregation from RSQ demographics endpoint

name: Resettlement Submissions — Children Share (0-17, annual)
note: Child share in resettlement submissions; vulnerability structure of displaced cohort, fragility signal

name: Refugee Hosting Concentration (share in top-3 asylum countries, derived)
note: Geographic concentration of outflowing refugees; measures whether displacement is regional vs globally dispersed

name: Total Pending Asylum Cases Stock (end-year, country of asylum)
note: Accumulated unresolved asylum applications; measures system backlog and unresolved protection needs

name: Conflict New Displacements (annual flow)
note: New internal displacement movements triggered by conflict/violence in the year; a person displaced twice counted twice — flow measure

name: Conflict IDP Stock (end-year total)
note: Total people living in conflict-induced internal displacement at year-end; headline fragility and crisis duration indicator

name: Disaster New Displacements (annual flow)
note: New internal displacements caused by sudden-onset natural disasters in the year; climate-risk and resilience signal

name: Disaster IDP Stock (end-year total)
note: People in protracted disaster-induced displacement at year-end; reflects unresolved disaster exposure without durable solutions

name: Total New Displacements (conflict + disaster, annual flow)
note: Combined new displacement movements from all causes; aggregate mobility-shock signal for ML

name: Total IDP Stock (conflict + disaster, end-year)
note: Combined end-year IDP stock from all causes; broadest internal displacement measure available from IDMC

name: Conflict New Displacements per 1,000 Population (normalized)
note: Conflict-induced new displacements normalized by population; cross-country comparability for ML features

name: Conflict IDP Stock per 1,000 Population (normalized)
note: Conflict IDP stock normalized by population; intensity-adjusted internal displacement burden

name: Disaster New Displacements per 1,000 Population (normalized)
note: Disaster displacement flow normalized by population; disaster vulnerability intensity metric

name: Disaster IDP Stock per 1,000 Population (normalized)
note: Disaster IDP stock normalized by population; protracted climate/natural hazard exposure signal

name: Conflict Displacement — Geopolitical Violence Events (annual count)
note: Count of IDU-recorded conflict displacement events classified as geopolitical violence; from IDMC event-level /disaster_events/ endpoint

name: Disaster Displacement — Flood-Related New Displacements (annual)
note: New displacements caused specifically by flood events; disaggregated hazard type from IDMC /aggregated/disaster_data/

name: Disaster Displacement — Storm-Related New Displacements (annual)
note: New displacements from storm/cyclone events; extreme weather fragility signal disaggregated by hazard

name: Disaster Displacement — Earthquake New Displacements (annual)
note: New displacements from seismic events; geophysical risk measure disaggregated from IDMC disaster events

name: Disaster Displacement — Drought-Related New Displacements (annual)
note: New displacements from drought events; climate-stress and food-security fragility signal

name: Disaster Displacement — Wildfire New Displacements (annual)
note: New displacements from wildfire events; increasingly relevant climate-change-linked displacement driver

name: Disaster Displacement — Volcanic Activity New Displacements (annual)
note: New displacements from volcanic eruptions; geophysical hazard disaggregation for island/volcanic-zone countries

name: Disaster Displacement — Landslide New Displacements (annual)
note: New displacements from mass movement/landslide events; terrain-risk and precipitation-interaction signal

name: Disaster Displacement — Tsunami New Displacements (annual)
note: New displacements from tsunami events; low-frequency, high-impact coastal exposure signal

name: Years in Consecutive Conflict Displacement (derived from IDMC stock series)
note: Count of consecutive years with conflict IDP stock > 0; protracted displacement duration, chronicity indicator

name: Number of Conflict Displacement Events (annual count, from IDU)
note: Count of distinct displacement trigger events from Internal Displacement Updates; event frequency signal

name: Number of Disaster Displacement Events (annual count, from IDU)
note: Count of distinct disaster events causing displacement; disaster frequency signal from /disaster_events/ endpoint

name: IDMC Data Confidence Assessment Score (country-year)
note: IDMC's own data reliability score for country-year displacement estimates; useful as feature weight or exclusion filter

name: Conflict IDP Stock Year-on-Year Change (derived)
note: Annual delta in conflict IDP stock; distinguishes worsening vs stabilizing displacement situations

name: Disaster IDP Stock Year-on-Year Change (derived)
note: Annual delta in disaster IDP stock; captures whether protracted disaster displacement is growing or resolving

name: State-Based Armed Conflict Active (binary, country-year)
note: Binary flag: at least one active state-based armed conflict in the country-year (from OrganizedViolenceCY); conflict presence indicator

name: Non-State Armed Conflict Active (binary, country-year)
note: Binary flag: non-state conflict (no government party) active in country-year; communal violence and militia conflict signal

name: One-Sided Violence Active (binary, country-year)
note: Binary flag: one-sided violence against civilians active in country-year; atrocity and targeting of civilians signal

name: Intrastate State-Based Conflict Active (binary, country-year)
note: Binary: intrastate state-based conflict active; distinguishes internal civil war from interstate conflict

name: Interstate State-Based Conflict Active (binary, country-year)
note: Binary: interstate conflict between governments active in country-year; external threat and cross-border war signal

name: State-Based Conflict Battle Deaths — Best Estimate (country-year aggregate)
note: Best-estimate battle-related deaths from state-based conflicts aggregated to country-year; core conflict intensity metric

name: State-Based Conflict Battle Deaths — Low Estimate (country-year)
note: Lower-bound battle death estimate; captures uncertainty range for conflict intensity in ML feature engineering

name: State-Based Conflict Battle Deaths — High Estimate (country-year)
note: Upper-bound battle death estimate; uncertainty spread (high-low) is itself a useful feature signaling data opacity

name: Non-State Conflict Deaths — Best Estimate (country-year aggregate)
note: Best-estimate fatalities from non-state (communal/militia) conflicts aggregated to country-year; sub-state violence level

name: Non-State Conflict Deaths — Low Estimate (country-year)
note: Lower-bound non-state conflict fatality estimate; uncertainty floor for communal violence intensity

name: Non-State Conflict Deaths — High Estimate (country-year)
note: Upper-bound non-state conflict fatality estimate; uncertainty ceiling for communal violence signal

name: One-Sided Violence Deaths — Best Estimate (country-year aggregate)
note: Best-estimate civilian fatalities from one-sided violence aggregated to country-year; targeted killing and atrocity intensity

name: One-Sided Violence Deaths — Low Estimate (country-year)
note: Lower-bound civilian deaths from one-sided violence; floor estimate for atrocity magnitude

name: One-Sided Violence Deaths — High Estimate (country-year)
note: Upper-bound civilian deaths from one-sided violence; ceiling estimate, spread signals reporting uncertainty in repressive states

name: Total Organized Violence Deaths — Best Estimate (all three types, country-year)
note: Sum of state-based + non-state + one-sided best-estimate deaths; mutually exclusive categories so summable without double-count

name: Number of Active State-Based Conflicts (country-year count)
note: Count of distinct state-based conflict dyads active in country-year; multi-front war complexity signal

name: Number of Active Non-State Conflicts (country-year count)
note: Count of distinct non-state conflict dyads in country-year; militia/communal fragmentation signal

name: Number of Active One-Sided Violence Actors (country-year)
note: Count of distinct actors committing one-sided violence in country-year; plurality of targeting actors, repression breadth

name: State-Based War Intensity Flag (≥1000 deaths, binary, country-year)
note: Binary: state-based conflict reaches 'war' threshold (≥1,000 battle deaths); from incompatibility coding in PRIO-ACD dataset

name: Territorial Incompatibility Conflict Active (binary, country-year)
note: Binary: conflict over control of territory (as opposed to government) active; separatism/secessionism signal

name: Government Incompatibility Conflict Active (binary, country-year)
note: Binary: conflict over control of central government active in country-year; coup/revolution/insurgency signal

name: Extra-Systemic (Colonial/Imperial) Conflict Active (binary, country-year)
note: Binary: extra-systemic armed conflict (colonial or imperial) active; from type_of_conflict=1 in PRIO-ACD

name: State-Based Conflict Onset (binary: new conflict in year, country-year)
note: Binary flag for new conflict onset from UCDP Onset Dataset; leading rather than contemporaneous conflict signal

name: State-Based Conflict Reactivation (binary, country-year)
note: Binary: previously terminated conflict re-escalated; signals fragility of peace agreements and ceasefire fragility

name: Conflict Termination Event (binary, from UCDP Termination Dataset)
note: Binary: at least one conflict dyad terminated in country-year; conflict resolution/ceasefire signal

name: Termination by Peace Agreement (binary, country-year)
note: Conflict ended via formal peace agreement; quality-of-peace signal — negotiated settlements vs military victory

name: Termination by Ceasefire (binary, country-year)
note: Conflict ended by ceasefire agreement; fragile termination type, historically high recurrence risk

name: Termination by Military Victory (binary, country-year)
note: Conflict ended by decisive military victory; durability signal — military victories have lower recurrence than ceasefires

name: GED State-Based Violence Events Count (country-year aggregate)
note: Count of georeferenced state-based violence events in country-year from GED; event frequency intensity indicator

name: GED Non-State Violence Events Count (country-year aggregate)
note: Count of georeferenced non-state conflict events in country-year; communal violence frequency signal

name: GED One-Sided Violence Events Count (country-year aggregate)
note: Count of georeferenced one-sided violence events; civilian targeting frequency, atrocity event density

name: GED Civilian Deaths Best Estimate (all violence types, country-year)
note: Sum of deaths_civilians across all GED events in country-year; direct civilian harm signal from all organized violence

name: GED Total Deaths Best Estimate (all types combined, country-year)
note: Aggregate of best-estimate deaths from all GED events (SB+NS+OS) in country-year; total lethality from organized violence

name: GED Geographic Spread (count of distinct ADM1 regions with events, country-year)
note: Number of distinct first-level administrative regions with GED events; spatial diffusion of conflict, territorial control signal

name: GED PrioGrid Cell Spread (count of distinct 0.5-degree cells with events, country-year)
note: Number of distinct PRIO-GRID cells with violence events; fine-grained geographic diffusion of organized violence

name: Government as Conflict Party (binary, country-year)
note: Binary: country's government is an active party to state-based conflict; direct regime-survival threat signal

name: External Support to Conflict Parties (binary, from ESD dataset)
note: Binary: at least one warring party receiving external state support; internationalization and proxy-war signal

name: External Support Type (troops/weapons/finance, ordinal, from ESD)
note: Type of external support provided to conflict parties; differentiates material (troops/weapons) from logistic/financial support

name: Violent Political Protests — Dyad Count (country-year)
note: Count of violent political protest dyads from UCDP Violent Political Protest Dataset; sub-conflict political unrest level

name: Violent Political Protest Deaths (country-year aggregate)
note: Fatalities from violent political protests (below armed conflict threshold); protest repression and political volatility signal

name: Rebel Group Territorial Demands Active (binary, country-year)
note: Binary: rebel groups with stated territorial/autonomy demands active; from UCDP Conflict Issues Dataset, secessionism signal

name: Rebel Group Ideological/Revolutionary Demands Active (binary, country-year)
note: Binary: rebel groups seeking regime change on ideological grounds; revolutionary vs. separatist conflict type distinction

name: Government-Perpetrated One-Sided Violence Active (binary, country-year)
note: Binary: government is perpetrator of one-sided violence against civilians; state repression / democide signal

name: Non-State Actor One-Sided Violence Active (binary, country-year)
note: Binary: non-state armed group committing one-sided violence; terrorism / insurgent targeting signal distinct from state repression

name: Government-Perpetrated Civilian Deaths Best Estimate (one-sided, country-year)
note: Fatalities from government one-sided violence; state atrocity magnitude, distinct from battlefield deaths

name: Non-State Actor Civilian Deaths Best Estimate (one-sided, country-year)
note: Fatalities from non-state one-sided violence; insurgent/terrorist targeting of civilians intensity

name: Peace Agreement Signed (binary, country-year, from UCDP PAD)
note: Binary: at least one peace agreement signed in country-year; peace process milestone signal from UCDP Peace Agreement Dataset

name: Peace Agreements Signed Count (country-year)
note: Number of peace agreements signed; multiple agreements may reflect repeated failures or comprehensive peacebuilding

name: Maximum Battle Deaths Across Dyads (country-year, most lethal dyad)
note: Battle deaths of most lethal single conflict dyad; captures dominant conflict without dilution from minor simultaneous conflicts

name: State-Based Conflict Dyad Count (country-year)
note: Number of distinct state-based dyads (government vs. each armed group) active in country-year; multi-party conflict complexity

name: Total Organized Violence Deaths Log-Transformed (country-year, derived)
note: Natural log of total organized violence deaths; reduces skew for ML regression features, preferred transformation for lethality

name: Conflict Duration (years since first onset, country-year)
note: Years elapsed since first conflict onset in country; chronicity signal — long-running conflicts have different risk profiles

name: Country is Primary Battle Location (binary, country-year)
note: Binary: country is the primary geographic location of state-based conflict (gwno_loc matches country); direct vs spillover risk

name: Candidate Events Monthly Count (nowcast, country-year partial)
note: Monthly candidate GED events (1-month lag release); enables quasi-real-time annualization for nowcasting features

name: Non-State Conflict Organization Type (communal vs. organized, country-year flag)
note: Whether non-state violence is between communal groups vs organized armed groups (org variable); violence type differentiation

name: Ethnic Civilian Targeting Active (binary, from EOSV dataset)
note: Binary: one-sided violence with ethnic identity targeting of victims active; ethnic persecution and atrocity risk signal

name: Deadly Electoral Violence Events (count, country-year, from DECO)
note: Count of georeferenced lethal electoral violence events; election-period instability signal distinct from armed conflict

name: GED Intrastate Civil War Deaths Best Estimate (country-year)
note: GED-aggregated battle deaths from intrastate conflict type; separates civil war mortality from interstate conflict deaths

name: GED Interstate War Deaths Best Estimate (country-year)
note: GED-aggregated battle deaths from interstate conflict; international war mortality distinct from internal conflict signal

name: GED Active Conflict Years (count of years with events, derived)
note: Rolling count of years with active GED events for a country; persistence / conflict-years-experienced signal

name: Refugee Flow to Top Destination Country (persons, annual, by origin)
note: Largest single-country refugee outflow direction from origin country; bilateral route concentration signal

name: Refugees Hosted as Share of Regional Total (derived, country-year)
note: Share of regional refugee hosting burden borne by country; burden-sharing and regional solidarity indicator

name: Asylum Backlog Duration (pending stock / annual decisions, derived)
note: Implied years to clear pending asylum backlog at current decision rate; institutional capacity and rule-of-law proxy

name: Extreme Conflict Displacement Year Flag (top decile globally, derived)
note: Binary: conflict displacement in top 10% globally for that year; threshold-crossed signal for ML classification

name: Extreme Disaster Displacement Year Flag (top decile globally, derived)
note: Binary: disaster displacement in top 10% globally for that year; extreme climate-event signal

name: One-Sided Violence Share of Total Organized Violence Deaths (derived)
note: Civilian-targeting deaths as fraction of total organized violence deaths; measures targeting-of-civilians vs combatant-focus shift

name: Non-State to State-Based Violence Lethality Ratio (derived)
note: Ratio of non-state deaths to state-based deaths; measures whether violence is dominated by sub-state militia vs government conflict

name: State-Based Conflict Intensification (year-on-year death change, derived)
note: Year-on-year delta in state-based battle deaths; escalation vs de-escalation direction signal for trend detection

name: UNHCR IDP Stock Annual Change Rate (%, derived)
note: Percentage change in UNHCR-reported IDP stock year-on-year; acceleration of displacement crisis or recovery signal

name: Refugee Outflow Rate (new refugees as % of prior-year stock, derived)
note: Pace at which refugee stock is being augmented; crisis velocity indicator separate from absolute magnitude

name: Durable Solutions Rate (solutions as % of refugee stock, derived)
note: Share of refugee population accessing durable solutions annually; crisis resolution pace and international burden-sharing signal

name: GED Mean Death Estimate Uncertainty (high-low spread, country-year mean)
note: Average (high-low) uncertainty range across GED events in country-year; proxy for conflict opacity and media access restrictions

name: GED Low-Clarity Events Share (country-year, % events with low event_clarity)
note: Share of GED events with low coding clarity (event_clarity field); information opacity signal correlated with media suppression

name: Disaster Displacement — Extreme Temperature Events (annual new displacements)
note: Displacement from extreme heat/cold events; climate-stress signal distinct from storm/flood displacement

name: Disaster Displacement — Wet Mass Movement (mudslide/debris, annual new displacements)
note: Displacement from wet mass movement (rain-triggered landslides); precipitation-slope interaction risk signal

name: Stateless Population ≥10,000 (binary, country-year)
note: Binary: stateless population exceeds 10,000 — threshold for internationally significant statelessness situation

name: Refugee to Population Ratio in Asylum Country (%, derived)
note: Refugees as share of asylum country population; measures pressure on protection space and potential for social tension

name: Internationalised Intrastate Conflict Active (binary, type_of_conflict=3, country-year)
note: Binary: civil war with foreign state involvement (type_of_conflict=3 in PRIO-ACD); proxy war / internationalization signal

name: Pure Intrastate Conflict Active (binary, type_of_conflict=2, country-year)
note: Binary: domestic civil war without external state involvement (type_of_conflict=2); separates proxy wars from purely internal

name: Conflict New Displacements 5-Year Rolling Average (derived)
note: 5-year moving average of conflict new displacements; smoothed trend that reduces single-year event spikes for ML stability

name: Disaster New Displacements 5-Year Rolling Average (derived)
note: 5-year moving average of disaster new displacements; baseline climate exposure trend smoothed over medium term

name: Asylum Applications Growth Rate (YoY %, country of asylum)
note: Year-on-year growth rate of new asylum applications received; migration pressure acceleration signal for receiving states

name: Refugee Origin Concentration Index (HHI across origin countries, derived)
note: Herfindahl index of refugee hosting country's origin-country mix; concentrated=single crisis, dispersed=structural inflow

name: Average Battle Deaths per State-Based Violence Event (country-year, derived)
note: Mean lethality per GED event; distinguishes mass-casualty events from diffuse attrition warfare

name: Average Deaths per Non-State Violence Event (country-year, derived)
note: Mean lethality per non-state GED event; massacre vs skirmish distinction in communal violence

name: Average Deaths per One-Sided Violence Event (country-year, derived)
note: Mean civilian deaths per one-sided violence event; tactical pattern of targeting — mass atrocities vs targeted killings

name: GED Events with Unclear Temporal Precision (country-year share, derived)
note: Share of events with low temporal precision (date_start ≠ date_end span >1 month); reporting opacity index

name: Total Displaced Persons to GDP Ratio (derived, IDMC stock / WB GDP)
note: IDP stock relative to economic size; economic displacement burden signal independent of population scale

name: Country Ever Had UCDP-Recorded Conflict (binary, cumulative through year)
note: Binary: country has experienced any UCDP-recorded organized violence by current year; historical conflict legacy signal

name: Years Since Last Active Conflict (country-year, derived)
note: Years elapsed since last UCDP-recorded organized violence above threshold; post-conflict stability duration, recurrence risk proxy

name: Communal Non-State Conflict Share (% of NS conflicts that are communal, country-year)
note: Fraction of non-state conflicts that are communal (ethnic/religious) vs organized armed group; conflict type composition signal

name: Refugee Inflow to Country of Asylum (new arrivals, annual flow)
note: New refugee arrivals in country-year as asylum destination; immigration pressure and humanitarian burden signal

name: Stateless Population Change (year-on-year delta)
note: Annual change in stateless population; growing statelessness signals policy exclusion or denaturalization campaigns

name: GED Communal Non-State Violence Deaths (country-year, best estimate)
note: Deaths from communal non-state violence (ethnic/religious clashes); social fragmentation and intercommunal tension signal

name: GED Organized Non-State Violence Deaths (country-year, best estimate)
note: Deaths from organized armed group non-state conflicts; militia/criminal organization violence separate from communal clashes

name: Cumulative Disaster Displacements Over Past 10 Years (derived)
note: 10-year sum of annual disaster new displacements; chronic climate exposure signal for structural risk assessment

name: Cumulative Conflict Displacements Over Past 10 Years (derived)
note: 10-year sum of annual conflict new displacements; chronic conflict-driven displacement exposure signal

name: Human Development Index
note: Composite index of life expectancy, education, and GNI per capita; 1990-2023 annual time series for ~193 countries

name: Human Development Index Rank
note: Country rank on HDI; ordinal position among ~193 countries annually

name: Life Expectancy at Birth
note: Life expectancy (years) used as HDI health component; HDR-harmonized series distinct from WB SP.DYN.LE00.IN

name: Expected Years of Schooling
note: Expected years of schooling for children of school-entry age; HDI education component

name: Mean Years of Schooling
note: Average years of schooling for adults 25+; HDI education component

name: Gross National Income Per Capita (PPP 2017 USD)
note: GNI per capita in constant 2017 PPP international $; HDI income component; HDR-harmonized

name: Inequality-Adjusted Human Development Index
note: HDI adjusted for inequality in health, education, and income; discount from HDI captures inequality penalty

name: Overall Loss in HDI Due to Inequality (%)
note: Percentage difference between HDI and IHDI; overall inequality penalty on human development

name: Inequality in Life Expectancy
note: Atkinson measure of inequality in distribution of expected length of life within a country

name: Inequality in Education
note: Atkinson measure of inequality in years of schooling distribution; captures within-country education gap

name: Inequality in Income
note: Atkinson measure of income inequality used in IHDI computation; distinct from Gini

name: Gender Development Index
note: Ratio of female to male HDI; captures gender gaps in health, education, and income dimensions

name: HDI Female
note: Human Development Index computed for female population; component of GDI

name: HDI Male
note: Human Development Index computed for male population; component of GDI

name: Female Life Expectancy at Birth
note: Life expectancy at birth for females; GDI health sub-component

name: Male Life Expectancy at Birth
note: Life expectancy at birth for males; GDI health sub-component

name: Expected Years of Schooling (Female)
note: Expected years of schooling for girls of school-entry age; GDI education sub-component

name: Expected Years of Schooling (Male)
note: Expected years of schooling for boys of school-entry age; GDI education sub-component

name: Mean Years of Schooling (Female)
note: Mean years of schooling for women aged 25+; GDI education sub-component

name: Mean Years of Schooling (Male)
note: Mean years of schooling for men aged 25+; GDI education sub-component

name: GNI Per Capita (Female, PPP 2017 USD)
note: Estimated GNI per capita for females; GDI income sub-component

name: GNI Per Capita (Male, PPP 2017 USD)
note: Estimated GNI per capita for males; GDI income sub-component

name: Gender Inequality Index
note: Composite index of reproductive health, empowerment, and labour market gender inequality; 0=equal, 1=maximum inequality

name: Gender Inequality Index Rank
note: Country rank on GII; country ordering on gender inequality

name: Maternal Mortality Ratio
note: Deaths per 100,000 live births; GII reproductive health component; proxy for healthcare system adequacy

name: Adolescent Birth Rate
note: Births per 1,000 women aged 15-19; GII reproductive health component; fragility and health system signal

name: Female Population with at Least Some Secondary Education (%)
note: Share of females 25+ with at least some secondary education; GII empowerment component

name: Male Population with at Least Some Secondary Education (%)
note: Share of males 25+ with at least some secondary education; GII empowerment component

name: Female Share of Parliament Seats (%)
note: Share of seats in national parliament held by women; GII empowerment component; political inclusion signal

name: Male Share of Parliament Seats (%)
note: Share of seats in national parliament held by men; GII empowerment component complement

name: Female Labour Force Participation Rate (%)
note: Female share of working-age population in labour force; GII labour market component; economic inclusion signal

name: Male Labour Force Participation Rate (%)
note: Male share of working-age population in labour force; GII labour market complement

name: Planetary Pressures-Adjusted Human Development Index
note: HDI discounted by planetary pressure (CO2 emissions + material footprint); captures sustainability-adjusted development

name: Difference between HDI and PHDI
note: Planetary pressure penalty on HDI; higher values = worse environmental footprint relative to development level

name: CO2 Emissions Per Capita (production-based, tonnes)
note: Per capita CO2 emissions from production; PHDI planetary pressure component

name: Material Footprint Per Capita (tonnes)
note: Total raw material extraction attributed to domestic final demand per capita; PHDI planetary pressure component

name: Multidimensional Poverty Index
note: Composite index of acute poverty across health, education, and living standards; 0-1 scale from household surveys

name: Multidimensional Poverty Headcount (%)
note: Share of population classified as multidimensionally poor (deprived in 1/3+ of weighted indicators)

name: Intensity of Multidimensional Poverty (%)
note: Average share of weighted deprivations among the multidimensionally poor; breadth of poverty signal

name: Contribution of Nutrition to MPI (%)
note: Share of MPI score driven by nutrition deprivation; fragility health signal

name: Contribution of Child Mortality to MPI (%)
note: Share of MPI score driven by child mortality deprivation; acute welfare signal

name: Contribution of Years of Schooling to MPI (%)
note: Share of MPI score from schooling deprivation; education exclusion signal

name: Contribution of School Attendance to MPI (%)
note: Share of MPI score from school attendance deprivation; present-tense education access

name: Contribution of Cooking Fuel to MPI (%)
note: Share of MPI from cooking fuel deprivation (reliance on solid fuels); infrastructure/energy access signal

name: Contribution of Sanitation to MPI (%)
note: Share of MPI from sanitation deprivation; infrastructure and public health signal

name: Contribution of Drinking Water to MPI (%)
note: Share of MPI from unsafe drinking water deprivation; acute fragility and state capacity signal

name: Contribution of Electricity to MPI (%)
